meta.definition: depth_rank is the ordinal of the player within (team, position) on the newest depth-chart snapshot, ordered by pos_slot then pos_rank; the raw pos_slot and pos_rank_in_slot are kept on every row. NULL means the player has no depth-chart row and is NOT counted as a starter. weighted_depth_lost = sum(1/rank) over absences with a known rank. positions_down lists positions where the best available player is 2nd string or deeper because everyone ahead of him is Out/Doubtful.
caveats: 'Out' is a final designation; 'Doubtful' is a probability the league does not quantify. Both are reported separately and neither is a performance claim.
'Not injury related - resting player' / 'personal matter' rows exist in the feed and are counted in out_or_doubtful; they are disclosed, not filtered.
Depth charts are club-supplied and scraped; a rank can lag a transaction and does not by itself show who will take the snaps.
Snap share is joined through the roster's pfr_id (the snap-count feed has no gsis_id); 2372 of 12693 snap rows had no crosswalk.
Nothing here says a backup will play, or how well.
